newsitem.title: USA: Dimon in talks to acquire Intabex Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Dimon in talks to acquire Intabex Holdings.

text.p: Dimon Inc said Tuesday it is in talks to acquire Intabex Holdings Worldwide SA, the world's fourth largest leaf tobacco dealer, with annual sales of about $700 million.
Dimon said no definitive agreement had been reached.
The company said in a release that its officials had no further comment.
Dimon said it is the world's second largest leaf tobacco dealer and the largest exporter and importer of fresh-cut flowers.
Dimon shares were off one early Tuesday afternoon at 22-1/4.
